universal_patterns.pattern: any holder of a license[^.]*under this title

proposal.rationale: SC Title 40 is the Professions and Occupations title; Chapter 1 contains umbrella provisions administered by the Department of Labor, Licensing and Regulation. Section 40-1-20 uses "As used in this title" which signals title-wide definitions. Section cites in SC look like "Section 40-1-20" — the chapter token is the middle segment (e.g., "1"). Chapter cites use bare "Chapter NN". Note that SC uses "article" within chapters as a subdivision, so article-level universal patterns are treated as chapter-tier. The narrow "this chapter applies only to regulation by the department" style language is deliberately excluded so DLLR-scoped provisions surface in triage.
